title: Fun gift. The kid really like it.
text:
My son gets excited when his shirt comes every month.

They are definitely nerd shirts so be ready to commit to your nerdiness.

I would have liked to see more samples of what might be included in the listing but the surprise is fun too, for him at least.

Started w a L but after the first month went to XL and that for him perfectly.

Plus he wears out his shirts so it’s a nice rotation of getting clean new clothes in for him!

This is this months shirt.
label: positive
